title: Bloodline Mist
next_chapter_hook: The third page of the Tianji Record slowly unfurled, and on the yellowed silk, a line of blood-colored characters emerged—'The Chen bloodline shall not perish, Heavenly Fate shall not extinguish, in three months, the blood shall reunite'—and the brushwork of those blood characters was exactly the same as what Chen Ji had seen in his dreams.

text.content: Ye Qing's words struck like thunder in Chen Ji's mind. The Demonic Path commander, surname Chen. This information was too shocking, causing his typically calm features to crack for a moment. He stood in place, pupils slightly constricted, fingers unconsciously gripping his sleeve tighter. "Which Chen?" His voice remained steady, but his speaking pace was half a beat faster than usual. Ye Qing looked at him, a complex light flickering in her eyes: "Yours, Chen." Chen Ji drew a deep breath, forcing himself to冷静下来。作为一个习惯扮猪吃虎的人，他太清楚情绪失控意味着什么。但此刻，一个他从未想过的可能正在他心底蔓延——难道他的身世，并非只是一个被遗弃的孤儿那么简单？

Ye Qing, seeing his silence, retrieved a jade slip from her sleeve and gently extended it before him. "This is a scroll fragment I accidentally discovered when infiltrating the Holy Sect's main hall." Her voice was extremely low. "It records a major upheaval within the Demonic Path a hundred years ago—a Chen surname general betrayed the Holy Sect, establishing his own faction and creating today's Demonic Path army. And his bloodline has always been regarded by the Holy Sect as an affliction that must be eradicated." Chen Ji took the jade slip, his divine sense probing within. A yellowed scene unfolded before his eyes—a blurry figure standing atop mountains of corpses and seas of blood, clutching an ancient scroll that radiated a sinister glow. That scroll's aura... was identical to the Tianji Record. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in Chen Ji's mind, carrying a seriousness never heard before: "Master, this matter... is far more complex than you can imagine."

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng... that Demonic Path commander, what exactly is his relationship with me?
dialogue.emotion: 压抑着惊涛骇浪般的震惊

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul quivered slightly within the first page of the Tianji Record, and after a long pause, spoke slowly: "Master, do you still remember your childhood?" Chen Ji's brow furrowed, attempting to recall. However, a terrifying realization struck him—he discovered that his memories before age seven were completely blank! Only some scattered fragments remained: hunger, cold, a blurry female figure, and... a burning village. "I... don't remember." Chen Ji's voice carried confusion for the first time. He had always believed that was due to memory blur from early wandering, but from Mo Xiansheng's tone, the matter was far from simple. "When the Tianqing Sect took you in, you were only seven years old. And that very year was when Chen Canghai, the Demonic Path commander, rose to prominence and unified the twelve divisions of the Demonic Path." Mo Xiansheng's voice grew increasingly grave, "This is by no means coincidence."

Chen Ji's heart skipped a beat. Chen Canghai—the Demonic Path commander's name. He had never imagined this name would have any connection to himself. As a Servant Disciple of the Tianqing Sect, he had always been content with his "waste" persona, secretly orchestrating the world, weaving a chess game no one could break. But now, a terrifying guess sprouted in his heart—if he truly was blood-related to the Demonic Path commander, then his "waste" persona was from the beginning built upon some deliberately erased memories? Ye Qing watched his expression change, saying softly: "I know this is hard to accept. But if you want to find answers, the Tianji Record may help you." She paused, "I heard that each page of the Tianji Record records different secrets. And the third page... is said to be about bloodline inheritance."

The third page of the Tianji Record..." Chen Ji murmured, repeating these words. His Tianji Record currently had only two fragments; the second page had just been unsealed not long ago. He had never seen the third page, didn't even know where it was. Mo Xiansheng's voice spoke again: "Master, the third page is not far out of reach. It has always been by your side, only sealed by some force." Chen Ji's heart stirred. He raised his hand to touch his chest—that was where the Tianji Record fragment was located. A warm sensation radiated from his fingertips, as if something slumbered within his flesh and blood. "To unseal the third page requires sufficient... Heavenly Fate." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a warning, "And every point of your Heavenly Fate is precious."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji faces a major decision—whether to consume Heavenly Fate now to unseal the third page of the Tianji Record and investigate the bloodline mystery?

choices.description: Risk activating the hidden information on the third page of the Tianji Record, consuming 15 points of Heavenly Fate to exchange for key clues about the bloodline truth.
choices.visible_reward: Key clues to the bloodline truth
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate is precious to begin with; such consumption may affect the use of foresight abilities later
choices.process_label: 陈机深吸一口气，将手掌按在天机录残页上

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes and probed his divine sense deep into the Tianji Record. A familiar burning sensation spread from his chest—that was the feeling of Heavenly Fate being extracted. Fifteen points—that was one-third of his current reserves. But he didn't hesitate, because he knew some truths were more important than current safety. Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in the darkness: "Good, Master. Your resolve... I have noted it." Deep within the Tianji Record, a page of yellowed silk slowly emerged, covered with dense ancient characters. Chen Ji gazed intently, his pupils suddenly contracting—it was a bloodline genealogy chart, and the first name marked on it was precisely the three characters "Chen Canghai."

choices.description: Suppress the urge to investigate, first analyze and deduce using existing information, avoiding wasteful consumption.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain strategic composure, preserve Heavenly Fate for future actions
choices.risk_hint: May miss a critical opportunity, but can better protect one's trump cards
choices.process_label: 陈机强压下心中的急切，恢复了惯常的冷静

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes and took a deep breath. When he opened his eyes again, the shock in his gaze had been perfectly replaced by composure. "Not urgent." He said lowly, "Showing my concern for this matter now would only打草惊蛇." Ye Qing愣了一下，随即露出一抹赞许的笑容："你比我想象的更沉得住气。" Chen Ji did not respond, but quickly deduced in his heart: if the Demonic Path commander was truly his blood relative, then the Holy Sect's pursuit of the Chen bloodline had an explanation. And the timing of Chen Nian being taken away almost coincided with when he obtained the Tianji Record—was there an invisible hand manipulating all of this behind the scenes?

Just as Chen Ji was contemplating, an astonishing scene suddenly flashed through his mind—that was a foresight automatically emerging from the Tianji Record. In the scene, a girl was imprisoned by chains in a dark underground stone chamber, her features exactly matching Chen Nian, the sister in Chen Ji's memory. And on the stone chamber's wall was carved an ancient line of text: "Chen Family Ancestral Land, Bloodline Imprisonment." Then another scene cut in—it was an ancient mansion long abandoned, the plaque faintly legible as the two characters "Chen Residence." The geographical location of this ancient mansion completely coincided with the Holy Sect's secret stronghold marked in the intelligence Ye Qing gave him! Chen Ji's breathing suddenly grew rapid, hands unconsciously clenching into fists. Chen Nian... she was actually held there?!

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng! My sister... she is at the old Chen Residence site?!
dialogue.emotion: 罕见地失控，声音中带着压抑不住的颤抖

text.content: Mo Xiansheng沉默片刻，缓缓开口："Master, I must提醒您——预见中出现的画面，往往并非简单的巧合。" His voice carried an unprecedented seriousness, "The Chen Family Ancestral Land was a forbidden area of a mysterious clan during ancient times. Legend has it that only those with the direct Chen bloodline can enter. The Holy Sect imprisoning Chen Nian there is by no means coincidence—they want to utilize her bloodline to open some kind of seal." Chen Ji forcefully suppressed his焦躁 in his heart, asking coldly: "What seal?" Mo Xiansheng's voice lowered: "That is precisely what the third page of the Tianji Record records, Master. Are you certain you wish to continue investigating? Once the truth is revealed, what you will face may not be just a Demonic Path commander, but the entire world's chess game."

Chen Ji fell silent. Ye Qing stood nearby, watching his tightly furrowed brow and slightly trembling fingertips, feeling an unprecedented emotion surge within her—so this man who was always calm and whose calculations never failed also had such a vulnerable side. "Chen Ji." She spoke softly, "Whatever decision you make, I can help you." Chen Ji raised his head and glanced at her. This Demonic Path Saint, from initial mutual exploitation to now fighting side by side, the relationship had quietly changed. "Do you know what you're saying?" His voice恢复了几分平静, "If I truly am blood-related to the Demonic Path commander, helping me is betraying your sect." Ye Qing's lips curved into a cold smile: "Betray? I've been used by the Holy Sect for so many years, and I've long wanted to personally overturn them."

choice.prompt: With Ye Qing expressing willingness to help, Chen Ji must decide his next move.

choices.description: Formally ally with Ye Qing, leveraging her intelligence network and Demonic Path fog abilities to jointly investigate the mystery of the Chen bloodline.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Ye Qing's Demonic Path intelligence support, as well as concealment of the Tianji Record's aura
choices.risk_hint: Cooperating with the Demonic Path Saint may arouse suspicion from orthodox sects
choices.process_label: 陈机凝视夜清片刻，终于点头

text.content: Chen Ji looked into Ye Qing's eyes, seeing no scheming, only something rare—sincerity. He suddenly smiled, the expression carrying a hint of self-mockery: "Fine. Since you're willing to wade through these troubled waters, I won't hold back." He raised his hand, revealing the Tianji Record Fragment in his palm. "From now on, you and I share intelligence. All information on the Demonic Path commander Chen Canghai—I want to know everything." A flash of joy appeared in Ye Qing's eyes before her composure returned: "Within three days, I'll have it delivered to you. Also..." She paused. "You'd better be careful about one person. Tianqing Sect's old Sect Master Ling Yuan—he's been secretly investigating your background."

choices.memory_label: 与夜清结为正式盟友，共同追查血脉之谜

choices.description: Avoid involving Ye Qing too deeply for now, so as not to expose more trump cards, maintaining single-line operations.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain operational concealment, leave no evidence
choices.risk_hint: May hurt Ye Qing's trust, miss an important ally
choices.process_label: 陈机轻轻摇头，表示暂时不需要

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his gaze and said coolly: "I appreciate your kindness. But this matter runs too deep, and I don't want to drag you into it." Ye Qing's expression stiffened momentarily before returning to normal: "You're always like this, pushing everyone away." She turned to leave but hesitated. "It doesn't matter, I'll keep an eye out for news for you. Just... don't carry everything alone next time." With that, her figure vanished into the night. Chen Ji watched her retreating back, a complex emotion rising in his heart. But he quickly suppressed this weakness—in this chess game, any emotion could become a vulnerability. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind: "Master is wise. The deeper the involvement, the faster the exposure. Maintaining mystery is the superior strategy."

After Ye Qing left, Chen Ji stood alone under the moonlight. The cool night breeze blew past, but couldn't dispel the restlessness in his heart. Chen Nian—that name echoed repeatedly in his mind. The sister who remained only a vague outline in his memory was now intimately connected to the mystery of his origins. Why did the Holy Sect capture her? What secrets lay hidden in the Chen ancestral land? What was the connection between Demonic Path commander Chen Canghai and himself? Countless questions swirled in his mind, each关乎生死, each demanding an answer. Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again, with a hint of sigh: "Master, you've already used the foresight ability twice today. If you continue like this, the Heavenly Fate value will..." Chen Ji coldly interrupted him: "I know. But some things are more important than my life."

Just then, an even more shocking foresight image涌入陈机脑海—untriggered by him, but a warning self-manifested by the Tianji Record. In the vision, the sky was dyed crimson by bloody clouds, corpses strewn across the ground. And atop the mountain of bodies, a man in black robes slowly turned around. The man's face bore a seventy percent resemblance to Chen Ji, only far more cold and authoritative. Madness gleamed in his eyes as his lips parted: "The Chen bloodline shall return." Before the vision dissipated, Chen Ji saw clearly the令牌 hanging at that person's waist—with the character "沧" engraved upon it. Chen Canghai's portrait—he had seen it on the Holy Sect's wanted notices. And that gesture... was clearly summoning something. Mo Xiansheng's voice abruptly tensed: "Master, that's—the summoning ritual of the Chen ancestral land!"

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. If Chen Canghai truly was summoning the Chen bloodline, then Chen Ji himself was one of those being summoned. And Chen Nian... as the purest "Heavenly Fate Lock Key" of the Chen bloodline, she might very well be the one used as a sacrifice! An unprecedented sense of crisis surged through him. He had always thought himself a chess player navigating grand schemes, never realizing that from the very beginning, he might have been merely a piece being manipulated. "Three months." Chen Ji said quietly, a cold gleam flickering in his eyes. "Chen Canghai has given me three months." Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment before saying: "That's not just time given to you, but also time for Chen Nian. If she cannot be rescued before then... the consequences will be unimaginable."

Chen Ji took a deep breath, pressing all emotions into the deepest recesses of his heart. When he raised his head again, his eyes had returned to their usual calm and depth. He began rapid calculations in his mind: three months to rescue Chen Nian, investigate his origins, uncover the secrets of the Chen ancestral land, while simultaneously dealing with the visible and hidden threats from Tianqing Sect, the Holy Sect's pursuit, and the potential bloodbath the Demonic Path commander might unleash... Every step was a game of life and death, every step allowing not the slightest error. In the past, he would have deemed this an impossible mission. But now, he possessed the Tianji Record, Ye Qing's assistance, and most importantly—he finally knew what he needed to protect. "Chen Nian..." he murmured softly. "Wait for me. This time, I'll be the one to save you."

dialogue.content: Master, are you certain you wish to walk this path? Once the bloodline tracing is initiated, there will be no turning back.

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer Mo Xiansheng's question. He raised his head and gazed toward Tianqing Sect. That sect had once been his shelter for survival, yet now it had become one of his greatest shackles. Ling Yuan—that seemingly benevolent old Sect Master secretly窥伺—could he be investigating his background at this very moment? Su Qingyao—that woman who had thrice come dangerously close to the truth—might she become a variable in his plans? And the existence暗中操纵—Heaven's Eye—had it long foreseen today's situation? Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile carrying a hint of sarcasm: "My entire life, I've been playing the role of a废物 in others' eyes. How laughable—only now do I realize perhaps from the very beginning, even my identity was arranged by others." He paused, a fierce light flashing in his eyes. "But it doesn't matter. Since the chessboard has been set, let me overturn it."

choice.prompt: Where should Chen Ji begin investigating the bloodline mystery?

choices.description: Return to the sect to investigate the adoption archive records, tracing the matter from its source while dealing with Ling Yuan's surveillance.
choices.visible_reward: May find adoption records, understand the truth of those years
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is already investigating secretly; returning may expose one's intentions
choices.process_label: 陈机转身，踏上返回天青宗的山路

text.content: The mountain gate of Tianqing Sect loomed indistinctly in the morning light. The moment Chen Ji stepped through the gate, he sensed an elusive divine consciousness sweeping over him—that was Ling Yuan's aura. Old fox... A cold smile formed in his heart, but on his face he wore an expression of timidity and cowardice, walking quickly toward the Servants' Quarters with his head bowed. A Servant Disciple passing by sneered: "Oh,废物 Chen going out to pick up scraps again?" Chen Ji didn't respond, only slightly hunching his shoulders, looking exactly like a pitiful wretch used to being bullied. Once that person walked away, the corner of his mouth curled into a cold smile: "I've noted this. Waiting for the right moment." Mo Xiansheng sighed in his mind: "Master's acting is unmatched in this world."

choices.text: Go to the old Chen estate first
choices.description: Go directly to scout the perimeter of the Holy Sect's secret stronghold without waiting for Ye Qing's intelligence, to confirm Chen Nian's exact location first.
choices.visible_reward: Might be able to locate Chen Nian's imprisonment location in advance
choices.risk_hint: Going deep into enemy territory alone carries extremely high exposure risk

text.content: Three days later, Chen Ji stood atop a desolate mountain peak. Before him lay ruins shrouded in thick fog. Crumbling walls, collapsed stone pillars, and mottled plaques—all spoke of the glory this place once knew. The faded characters "陈府" were still faintly distinguishable. Night wind carried a whiff of decay. Chen Ji closed his eyes, projecting his divine sense, only to encounter a powerful restriction—a primordial seal that only those with Chen bloodline could enter. He opened his eyes, a cold smile curling at his lips: "Interesting. The Holy Sect imprisoned my sister in a place only accessible to Chen bloodline. Are they convinced I wouldn't dare come, or are they waiting for me to walk into a trap?"

choices.description: Su Qingyao is the only person who noticed something amiss about him. Perhaps her position as Inner Disciple Senior Fellow could be leveraged to gather more intelligence.
choices.visible_reward: Might obtain Inner Sect intelligence support and a potential protector
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao is extremely intelligent and might see through more of the truth
choices.process_label: 陈机权衡利弊，决定冒险接触苏青瑶

text.content: Under the moonlight, Chen Ji stood on the path outside the Inner Disciple residences. After a moment, a cold voice came from the shadows: "Chen Ji? What are you doing here?" Su Qingyao stepped out slowly, the moonlight illuminating her frostily beautiful features, adding to her fierce aura. Chen Ji clasped his hands in salute, wearing an expression of being overwhelmed with gratitude: "Senior Sister Su, the junior... has something to consult you on." Su Qingyao narrowed her eyes, her scrutinizing gaze seemingly trying to see through him: "You have questions for me? I'd like to know how many secrets you're hiding." Chen Ji's heart chilled, but on his face was pure confusion: "What is Senior Sister saying? I'm merely a Servant Disciple, what secrets could I possibly have..." Su Qingyao snorted coldly, but didn't press further, simply saying: "Come in and speak."

The third page of the Tianji Record slowly unfurled. On the yellowed silk, a line of blood characters emerged—「陈氏不绝，天命不灭，三个月后，血脉重聚」—and the brushwork of those blood characters was exactly the same as what Chen Ji had seen in his dreams. Mo Xiansheng's voice resonated in his mind, carrying unprecedented gravity: "Master, this is the testament of the Tianji Record's original owner. And that original owner... also had the surname Chen." Chen Ji stared at the line of blood characters, his heart surging with tremendous waves. If the original owner of the Tianji Record was a Chen ancestor, then he, Chen Ji, was the inheritor of this ancient bloodline. And the Demonic Path commander Chen Canghai, the missing sister Chen Nian, even the Holy Sect's obsession with hunting him down—all of it pointed to the same source. "Chen clan..." he murmured, his eyes flashing with a complex light, "So the answer I've been seeking all along was carved into my bloodline itself."
